integrity_note: Exact finite-dimensional proof from Poissonization and strong-Markov renewal. Traditional finite arithmetic checks are supporting diagnostics, not infinite proofs. Independent literature priority and mathematical audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive type probabilities, fixed iid random scan, common loss probability \(p\in[0,1)\). No time-dependent/adaptive scans, heterogeneous losses, distributional majorization, or large-type asymptotics.
title: Exact first-passage transform and strict balancing law for nonuniform clumsy coupon collection
